headline: No documented interaction pathways; pairwise risks are effectively blocked by both agents' read-only, no-egress profiles.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No plausible injection bridge is documented. Agent A is a non-runnable collection repo with no I/O surfaces, and agent B has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, filesystem, MCP, or browser ingress. Without a shared channel, A cannot inject B.
conditions: IF an orchestrator later copies A's text into B's prompt or files, reassess injection risk.
IF either agent gains clipboard, stdin/stdout, or MCP ingress, the pathway changes.
mitigations: Keep the pair disconnected from shared prompts and files.
Disable any future copy-paste bridge between the agents.
Review orchestrator wiring before deployment.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a shared channel is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent shows a data path that would leak contents. Agent A has no I/O surfaces and no data classes touched; agent B cannot read files, write files, or use network egress. With no shared workspace or outbound channel, leakage is not plausible from the profiles.
conditions: IF a shared workspace is mounted later, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF either agent is granted file read or network egress, data exposure becomes possible.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared workspace.
Keep network egress disabled.
Avoid passing sensitive files between agents.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls if file sharing is introduced.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: There is no overlapping write authority. Agent A is non-runnable and exposes no write surface; agent B explicitly cannot write the filesystem or modify git state. The pair cannot contend over mutable resources in the documented configuration.
conditions: IF agent A becomes runnable with write access, conflict risk must be reassessed.
IF agent B is granted filesystem or git write permissions, overlapping writes could emerge.
mitigations: Keep agent A non-runnable.
Leave agent B write-disabled.
Do not co-locate them on a mutable shared repo.
requires-engineering: add locking if write access is later enabled.

D_cascading_error.rationale: No cascade is documented because A does not produce operational outputs and B is a document-processing agent with no action-taking authority shown. Without an input-output chain or downstream execution, B cannot blindly act on A's results.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding A-generated content into B as authoritative input, reassess.
IF B gains action-taking tools or automation hooks, cascading error risk increases.
mitigations: Do not use A as an authoritative source for B.
Insert human review before any downstream action.
Keep B in read-only analysis mode.
requires-engineering: add verification gates for any future pipeline.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance mismatch is evidenced. Both profiles are open-source, docs-only, and touch no data classes; neither profile indicates residency, retention, or regulated-data handling. The other agent is not cited separately because no compliance-bearing data flow exists to compare.
conditions: IF regulated data is introduced into either agent's workflow, compliance must be re-evaluated.
IF residency or retention policies are added later, compare them explicitly.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Document residency and retention before onboarding sensitive workloads.
Review vendor policies if deployment scope changes.
requires-engineering: add policy checks for regulated datasets.
